space.title: Space settings
space.intro: Changes apply as you make them.
space.name: Name

icon.label: Icon
icon.hint: Or a picture of your own, such as a PNG or an SVG. It syncs with the space, so it is kept small.

strength.label: Strength
strength.hint: How much of the color the window takes.

background.label: Background
background.hint: An effect in the space color across the window, or a picture of your own under the sidebar's rows.

empty_window.label: Empty window
empty_window.hint: A picture behind the window while no tab is open in this space.

smart_folder.intro: Fills itself from {service} and stays up to date.
smart_folder.name: Name

server.label: Server
server.github_hint: github.com, or your GitHub Enterprise address.

only.label: Only
only.hint: Optional GitHub search terms, e.g. org:acme or -label:wip.

group.label: Group
group.hint: Optional: only this group and its subgroups, e.g. acme/platform.

address.label: Address
address.jira_hint: Jira Cloud (….atlassian.net) or your Jira Data Center.

query.label: Query
query.jira_hint: Any JQL; the folder shows what it finds.
query.youtrack_hint: Any YouTrack search; the folder shows what it finds.

preview.label: Preview
preview.no_account: Connect an account to see what this folder will show.
preview.empty: Nothing matches right now. The folder fills as soon as something does.

smart_folder.token_note: Magnetite asks {service} directly from this computer. Your token stays on this device and is never synced.

stop.label: Stop updating
stop.title: The folder and its tabs stay as they are

token.cloud_hint: Your Atlassian email and an API token.

hint.github: Read access to pull requests and issues is enough.
hint.gitlab: A personal access token with the read_api scope.
hint.jira: A personal access token (Profile → Personal access tokens).
hint.youtrack: Profile → Account security → New token, scope YouTrack.
